skills.name: anti-slop-ui
skills.description: Bans generic AI frontend clichés (purple-blue gradients, bloated bento grids, unnecessary drop shadows) and enforces sharp, high-contrast, minimal layouts.

skills.name: api-contract-mocker
skills.description: Generates zero-dependency mock handlers and fixtures from API specs. Use when receiving OpenAPI schemas, Swagger JSON, or TypeScript interfaces to mock endpoints.

skills.name: context-diet
skills.description: Compresses source code and file context before passing to LLM reasoning. Use when ingesting files over 100 lines, preparing multi-file prompts, or pruning token bloat.

skills.name: env-auditor
skills.description: Cross-checks process.env, os.getenv, and configuration calls across the repository against .env.example to catch missing, mismatched, or leaked variables before deployment.

skills.name: loop-breaker
skills.description: If an agent fails a fix twice, it is blocked from editing code on turn 3 until it explains the broken root assumption and proposes a different approach.

skills.name: n-plus-one-hunter
skills.description: Scans ORM loops across Prisma, SQLAlchemy, Mongoose, Django, and TypeORM to identify hidden N+1 database queries, missing eager loading, and unindexed relation bottlenecks.

skills.name: pr-distiller
skills.description: Distills multi-file git diffs into executive risk and architecture reviews. Use when analyzing git diffs, reviewing pull requests, or preparing release changelogs.

skills.name: scope-guard
skills.description: Strictly forbids the agent from touching, "cleaning up," or refactoring files outside the exact function/component you asked it to edit.
